commands.name: canvas
commands.description: List the canvas panes, or close one

tools.name: show
tools.description: Show or update a pane beside the conversation that the user can read and click. Panels: markdown, stats tiles, a table, an SVG picture, a media set, and action buttons. The same id again replaces that pane in place; the result says whether it is drawn and does not echo the view. Buttons run a command only by NAME through the user's allowlist (an unknown name draws as a disabled "not allowed" button; you cannot add to the list), or put text in the user's draft box with "prompt" - nothing is sent for them. "refresh" re-runs an allowlisted command every few seconds and patches panels from the JSON it prints. The user closes a pane with /canvas close <id>.

tools.name: curate
tools.description: Open a set of media (audio, images, video, SVG, PDFs, text) in a pane for the user to curate: each item has a preview that fits the pane, and they keep, toss, maybe, pick or rate them with keys or buttons. Give "set" (an existing *.curate.json) or "items" with "title" and "mode". Returns at once with the number of items and does not echo them; the result arrives later as a prompt from the user when they finish (for pick-one, the moment they pick; otherwise when they press Done). Do not wait or poll, and do not call it again for a set that is already open: it only refocuses the pane.
